subject: Insurance
title: Tax-Free Death Benefits
description: A 60-second lesson on Tax-Free Death Benefits.

hook.text: Life insurance death benefits are tax-free in the US. A $1 million payout arrives as $1 million. The IRS takes nothing.

buildup.text: This tax exemption is one of insurance's biggest selling points. No income tax, no capital gains tax on the payout.

discovery.text: Wealthy families use life insurance as a tax shelter.

twist.text: Critics argue the tax break subsidizes the wealthy. A billionaire's heirs benefit most from tax-free millions.

climax.text: Tax-free death benefits are politically untouchable.

punchline.text: $1 million, tax-free. Life insurance is the last sacred tax shelter.

quiz.question: How are life insurance death benefits taxed in the US?
